newsitem.title: UK: Sunderland Football Club valued at 47.7 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Sunderland Football Club valued at 47.7 mln stg.

text.p: Premier League side Sunderland Association Football Club valued itself at 47.7 million stg on Tuesday ahead of plans to raise about 10.7 million stg through a flotation on the London Stock Exchange.
The north east English club, which has won the league title six times, the last in 1936, has set an offer price for each share at 585 pence.

According to its prospectus which was released on Tuesday, subscribers to the issue would need at least 585 stg to become a shareholder, as an applicant would have to apply for a minimum number of 100 ordinary shares.
Each applicant can apply for a maximum of 20,000 shares.
The club would be issuing 2.05 million shares, out of which 341,880 -- worth around two million stg -- would be offered to the public and employees.
The offer for subscription closes on December 19, with dealing slated to commence on December 24.
The club had earlier said the new funds would be used to add the finishing touches to a new 15 million stg stadium, reduce borrowing and fund the purchase of new players.
Sunderland was promoted to the premier league last season and forecast that increased gate receipts and television revenue would help double turnover this season to 13.6 million stg.
Premier league rivals Manchester United and Tottenham Hotspur have full stock market listings, while clubs such as Chelsea trade on the secondary market.
Others are expected to follow suit as revenue from a television deal with satellite broadcaster BSkyB and higher crowds help to transform the sport's finances.
